capabilities: display the focused file's full path in the status bar
copy the file path to the clipboard via click or command
toggle file name visibility in the path
choose relative or absolute path format
show icons for each path segment
extras: The status bar is not visible on mobile, so the path only shows on desktop; the copy command still works on Android but not iOS/iPadOS, though the plugin remains marked mobile-compatible.
problem: Obsidian's status bar doesn't show which file is open or where it sits in the folder tree, which is unclear with multiple panes open.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows the full path of the currently focused file, with per-segment icons and click-to-copy.
